header.title: Utably Import
header.subtitle: Job posting to application in one click.
privacy.title: Privacy and Data Use
privacy.intro: Utably Import is designed for user-controlled imports. We only collect and send data when you explicitly click Save to Utably or FitCheck.
privacy.bullet.userInitiated: User-initiated only: no background crawling across websites.
privacy.bullet.reviewFirst: Review-first flow: extracted fields are shown for editing before submit.
privacy.bullet.minimalPerms: Minimal permissions: host access is requested per site only when Auto-fill is used.
privacy.bullet.noCreds: No credential capture: extension does not read your passwords.
privacy.bullet.linkedin: LinkedIn mode: manual description entry by design.
privacy.bullet.tokens: Authentication uses short-lived extension tokens and revocable sessions.
privacy.legalIntro: Operated by Utably Limited (UK). For full legal terms and your data rights see:

fillConfirm.title: Confirm autofill
fillConfirm.intro: You are about to send fields from your Utably profile to a third-party website. Every recipient origin is listed below.
fillConfirm.empty: No matching fields detected on this page.
fillConfirm.changedNotice: The page changed since you last reviewed it. Please review the updated list below.
fillConfirm.remember: Don't ask again on this site
fillConfirm.rights: You can withdraw consent any time in Settings → Autofill privacy. Data leaves your browser only when you confirm and is placed directly into the page form by you.
privacy.bullet.profileFill: Profile autofill: when you press Fill this page, the extension fetches your Utably profile, shows you exactly which fields will be filled on which website, and only places data into the form after you confirm. The target website receives the data only if you submit the form.
privacy.bullet.profileCache: Profile cache: profile fields are cached in your browser's local storage for up to 5 minutes to power previews. Clear it any time under Settings → Autofill privacy.
privacy.bullet.profileConsent: Per-site consent: you can revoke the "don't ask again" consent for any site under Settings → Autofill privacy. Consents auto-expire after 30 days.
settings.privacy.title: Autofill privacy
settings.privacy.cacheMeta: Profile data is cached locally for 5 minutes for autofill previews.
